notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.content:
I moved the first key card to a more noticeable spot in the room because people couldn't find in on the shelf to the left of the door before, even using the torch.

Sprint re-gen has been sped up making it easier to escape when a creature is in pursuit.

Mini map has been added to help with maze traversal.

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content: The game kept getting interrupted by the end cut scene randomly playing during game play. Fixed this by adding branch feature to spacesuit making it only possible to activate endgame after you have collected the end space suit just before escaping the facility.
